scripts.install-all: npm install --prefix HexFront && npm install --prefix Bot && (cd 'Hex Stalcke' && python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt)
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:install: npm run test:install:frontend && npm run test:install:e2e && pip install pytest pytest-asyncio pytest-mock
scripts.test:install:frontend: cd HexFront && npm install -D vitest @testing-library/react @testing-library/dom jsdom
scripts.test:install:e2e: npm install -D @playwright/test && npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
